title: HR Recruiter
description:
Key Responsibilities

**1. Recruitment & Sourcing**

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle from sourcing to joining.
* Source candidates through job portals, social media, employee referrals, databases, and other recruitment channels.
* Screen resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
* Conduct initial telephonic screening and schedule interviews.
* Coordinate interviews with Centre Heads, Principals, Academic Heads, and Management.
* Maintain a strong candidate pipeline for current and future requirements.

**2. School Staff Recruitment**

* Recruit teachers for Pre-Primary, Primary, Middle, and Higher Grades.
* Recruit Principals, Coordinators, Academic Heads, Counsellors, Front Office staff, Admin staff, IT staff, and other non-teaching employees.
* Handle recruitment for housekeeping, security, transport, caretakers, and support staff as required.
* Understand the specific requirements of each school and recruit suitable candidates accordingly.

**3. Candidate Follow-up & Closure**

* Maintain regular follow-up with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
* Ensure candidates attend scheduled interviews and demo classes.
* Coordinate salary discussions and selection confirmation with the concerned management team.
* Ensure selected candidates complete the joining formalities within the committed timeline.
* Follow up with candidates after selection to minimize dropouts before joining.

**4. Recruitment Reporting**

* Maintain daily recruitment reports covering:
* Number of calls made
* Candidates contacted
* Profiles screened
* Interviews scheduled
* Interviews attended
* Candidates selected
* Offers released
* Candidates joined
* Pending positions
* Submit daily/weekly recruitment updates to the reporting manager.
* Track open positions and ensure timely closure of vacancies.

**5. Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with Centre Heads, Principals, Academic Heads, and HR regarding manpower requirements.
* Understand and communicate job descriptions, salary ranges, working hours, and other requirements to candidates.
* Maintain professional communication with candidates at all stages of recruitment.
* Address candidate queries regarding the recruitment and joining process.

**6. Documentation & HRMS**

* Ensure all selected candidates submit required joining documents.
* Coordinate with HR for offer letters, appointment documentation, and onboarding.
* Ensure candidate information is updated accurately in the HRMS/recruitment tracker.
* Maintain proper records of shortlisted, selected, rejected, and joined candidates.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of open positions.
* Number of qualified candidates sourced.
* Interview-to-selection ratio.
* Selection-to-joining conversion.
* Candidate follow-up and joining conversion.
* Quality and retention of hires.
* Daily recruitment reporting and tracker accuracy.
* Reduction in recruitment turnaround time.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong candidate sourcing and screening skills.
* Good negotiation and coordination skills.
* Ability to handle multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Strong follow-up and time-management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets and recruitment portals.
* Ability to work under recruitment targets and deadlines.
* Professional and positive attitude.

Qualification & Experience

* **Qualification:** Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or any relevant field.
* **Experience:** 1–4 years of recruitment experience preferred.
* Experience in **school/education recruitment** will be an added advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication and recruitment aptitude may also be considered.

Personal Attributes

* Result-oriented and target-driven.
* Responsible and accountable for assigned vacancies.
* Proactive in candidate sourcing and follow-up.
* Good interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* High level of professionalism and confidentiality.

Working Conditions

The Recruiter is expected to work closely with the HR team and school management and should be flexible to handle urgent hiring requirements, walk-in interviews, recruitment drives, and bulk hiring whenever required

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  

As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you will be the first point of contact for our clients, ensuring their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. You will proactively identify, investigate, and resolve technical incidents and problems, focusing on first\-line support for standard and low\-complexity incidents and service requests. Your aim? To ensure zero missed service level agreement conditions.  

  

Every day, you will monitor client infrastructure and solutions, identifying problems and errors before or as they occur. You will dive deep into first\-line incidents assigned to you, pinpointing the root causes, and providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support to our clients when they need it most. Maintenance activities, such as patching and configuration changes, will be part of your routine, ensuring the smooth operation of client systems.  

  

You will work across two or more technology domains, such as Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications, or Collaboration. Your day may include updating existing knowledge articles or creating new ones, seeking opportunities for work optimization, and supporting project work as needed. Additionally, you will contribute to disaster recovery functions and tests, ensuring our clients' DATA is safe and sound.  

  

Shift changes are made seamless with your careful handovers, ensuring service continuity. You will report and escalate incidents when necessary and strive for efficient, comprehensive resolutions of incidents and requests. With each interaction, you will aim to provide a positive client experience, placing their needs at the forefront of all you do.  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:*** Entry\-level experience with troubleshooting and support in security, network, DATA centre, systems, or storage within a medium to large ICT organization.
* Basic knowledge of management agents, redundancy concepts, and ITIL processes.
* Highly disciplined in handling of tickets on day\-to\-day basis. Act promptly as per defined Sop’s.
* Try to resolve as many tickets as possible using available Knowledge articles or provided Sop’s.
* Good understanding of using ITSM tools.
* Skill in planning activities and projects in advance and adapting to changing circumstances.
* A client\-centric approach, understanding their requirements and ensuring a positive experience throughout their journey.
* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Proficiency in active listening techniques and refraining from interrupting.
* A positive outlook at work, even in pressurized environments.
* Willingness to work hard and put in longer hours when necessary.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT or Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
**Workplace type****:**

On\-site Working **About NTT DATA**

Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through


responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

title: Professional, Integrations
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**

  

Job Description:


As an Integration Support Professional at Accurate, you will drive Accurate's future growth engine by assisting Accurate’s Onboarding Team and clients through the onboarding/integration process and turning them into happy users. Additionally, you will collaborate with multiple internal departments to ensure clients and Accurate are positioned for short and long term success.


A full degree of creativity and latitude are expected in this role to facilitate delivery of results to our business. Being consultative and solutions\-oriented are critical for this position.

 **This Role Is For You If:**

  

* You have an in\-depth understanding of integrated solutions using different methods of communication (i.e., API’s, periodic files, etc.).
* You have worked with cross\-functional teams to problem solve and provide ideal solutions to achieve client objectives.
* You thrive on the urgency and importance of working with our clients and are capable of independently triaging reported issues/bugs related to their integrated solution and leading the effort to resolve.
* You want to actively increase a client’s overall satisfaction with their integrated solution and help Accurate understand the benefits of client requested changes/improvements.
* You have the passion and drive to change the job applicant/candidate and recruiter experience for the better.
* You can engage in business\-level and technical conversations with internal and external clients.

  



At Accurate, we're transforming the background screening experience through innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to client success. As a fast\-growing organization, we partner with leading employers to deliver seamless screening and credentialing solutions that help build safer, more trusted workplaces. We foster a collaborative, results\-driven culture where new ideas are welcomed, learning is encouraged, and career growth opportunities are plentiful. If you're looking to make an impact while working alongside a talented team in a dynamic environment, Accurate could be the place for you.

 **Responsibilities:**

  

In this role, you will triage client reported issues in relation to their ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or API integrations. Additionally, you will assist clients and the Accurate Onboarding Team in integration configuration and testing, as well as answer open client questions in relation to integrations, provide clarification on solutions, etc.

  

* Act as an initial point of contact for all client reported integration issues or concerns through ticketing system.
* Troubleshoot complex data flow issues between Accurate and third\-party ATS, HRIS, and recruiting platforms.
* Analyze API requests, responses, error logs, and webhook deliveries to identify root causes of integration issues and either offer potential solutions OR escalate accordingly.
* Maintain communication with stakeholders regarding resolution of reported issues.
* Understand client integration requirements and system capabilities and be able to translate accordingly.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for platform\-specific integration capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
* Work closely with clients and ATS representatives to identify account setup and integration requirements.
* Work closely with Onboarding to properly configure clients for specific integrations, considering any client specific initiatives/requirements.
* Provide support for integration testing.
* Translate technical concepts into business\-friendly language for both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

 **Qualifications:**

  

* A familiarity with integrated API solutions and ability to explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to understand, evaluate, and translate complex client requirements into practical integration solutions.
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills combined with a commitment and proven ability to succeed within a fast\-paced organization.
* Strong overall interpersonal skills and a history exceeding client expectations.
* Time\-management skills and the ability to establish reasonable and attainable deadlines for resolution.
* Self\-motivated professional with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.
* Basic knowledge of XML and JSON required.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and databases required.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Experience with related tools such as Postman, SOAP UI, etc., a plus.
* Background Screening experience a plus.

**The Accurate Way:**
=====================


We offer a fun, fast\-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.

  



**Take ownership.**
===================


Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.


**Be open.**
============


Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.

**Stay curious.**
=================


Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.

**Work as one.**
================


Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

**Equal opportunities**
=======================


Accurate is an equal\-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

  

Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

  

You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.

**Special Notice:**
===================


Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.

* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in\-person format.

* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI\+ Data \+CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. The role of the Success Guide is crucial in helping customers to grow value and improve adoption of Salesforce. description:
**Talent Acquisition Intern**

**Duration \- 12 months**

**About Citco**

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end\-to\-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients needs.


For more information about Citco, please visit **www.citco.com**

**About the Team \& Business Line:**

Were a family\-owned business, not a faceless corporation. This personal approach informs every aspect of our customer service, where we develop long\-lasting relationships with our clients. But we dont stop there: we also build these same bonds among our own teams, too. Here, weve created a community where colleagues support one another and different departments help others succeed. And here, we’ve cultivated a culture where employees care about our company values and live them in their work. At Citco, this people\-centric philosophy is the core of who we are—and it shines through in everything we do, every day.


**Your role:**

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Intern who is eager to learn, hustle and take on new challenges in a fast paced environment.


\- You will be directly involved in finding and hiring top talent and learning the end to end recruitment lifecycle


\- Source and screen candidates


\- Assist in end to end recruitment


\- Coordinate and schedule interviews with candidates and hiring managers  



  

**About You:**

\- Fresher \- 1 year of experience


\- Passionate about making a career in Talent Acquisition


\- Energetic, dynamic, self motivated with a go getter attitude


\- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills


\- Willing to learn, take ownership and work in a fast paced environment


\- Basic knowledge of MS Excel


\- MBA / BBA / Any Graduate in HR or related field is a plus but not mandatory \- your attitude matters more!  



  

  

**Our Benefits**

Your well being is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.


We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.


Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.
